(2) Split pure validation (validate_root_layer_fractions returns names without copying rows; check_profile_ids inspects without conversion) from materialization (build_root_profile_table, materialize_profile_ids) which now run only after the aggregate init_bound preflight that includes profile mirrors; default-table byte guard moved out of validate_case so run_case returns status='rejected'; added mock-recorded ordering/refusal regression without large allocations. (3) scratch_allowance(P,N,L,n_profiles=2) adds S*L + 8*S profile-audit temporaries; actual S passed through all ledgers and the memory report. (4) Tests with test-only W overwrites now assert the audit residual equals the explicitly tracked external change with all other invariants true, plus a fresh unmodified 7-day run for full budget/growth; GPU heterogeneous test sets W0 to the chosen initial total before any advance. (5) Separate timed/synchronized profile H2D record (4P+8SL) and transfer_summary in results. (6) grass/shrub rows required only for classes actually present (counts before generation; is_shrub after supplied inputs); np.where no longer eagerly indexes absent names; tests cover grass-only, shrub-only, missing-required refusal and arbitrary names with explicit IDs. Kernels, fixture constants, caps and populations unchanged.

The CLI regression calls dwg.main in-process and prints progress to stderr. The supplied-inputs missing-class refusal happens after the preflight ledger (still before generation/transfer); the generated-case refusal happens before generation. The row-sum check iterates caller rows twice without copying; list IDs are checked element-wise in Python.
